title: Expenses
notBatches: Running costs only. Stock bought in batches goes through Batches, never here.
lockedHint: Paid from the drawer: the amount, date and method are fixed. Delete it while the shift is still open to put the cash back.

fields.fromDrawer: Paid now with cash from this counter's drawer (opens the drawer)
fields.noSession: Paying from the drawer needs an open shift on this counter

delete.title: Delete expense
delete.plain: The expense is removed from the reports.
delete.drawer: The cash goes back into the drawer: a pay-in of the same amount is recorded in this shift.
